subject: Candidate emergency: need to reschedule / format options
messages:
From: Barbara Kim <barbara@staffingpartners.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@gmail.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Interview confirmation — Data Engineer (DataViz Labs) — 3/16 10:00am PT

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for agreeing to interview Daniel Park for the Data Engineer role at DataViz Labs. The panel interview is scheduled for tomorrow, Fri 3/16 at 10:00am PT (60m). I attached his resume and sent the calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=0a1b2c3d4e5f.

Panel: Marcus Lin (Redwood Inference) — system design
Laura Bennett (Redwood Inference) — coding
Monica Patel (Redwood Inference) — ML/data pipelines
Stephanie Nguyen (Redwood Inference) — culture/team fit

Candidate contact: Daniel Park — daniel.park@gmail.com (cell: 415-555-0192)

Please let me know if you prefer splitting the session into two shorter blocks or if you want to move it to a different day.

Thanks,
Barbara Kim
Senior Recruiter — Staffing Partners
barbara@staffingpartners.com

Attachment: Daniel_Park_Resume.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@gmail.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Barbara Kim <barbara@staffingpartners.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 07:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview confirmation — Data Engineer (DataViz Labs) — 3/16 10:00am PT

Hi Marcus and Barbara,

I'm very sorry — I woke up this morning with a severe allergic reaction (face swelling, hives) and my doctor advised I shouldn't be on a video call today. I hate to do this last minute. I can provide a photo of the doctor's note if helpful.

If possible, I'd like to reschedule for tomorrow (Sat 3/17) or early next week. I can do Sat 3/17 after 1pm PT, or Mon/Tue between 2–5pm PT. If you prefer to proceed without me, I'm open to an asynchronous take-home exercise.

Again, apologies for the disruption and thank you for your flexibility.

— Daniel

(Attached: doc_note_park_0316.jpg)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@gmail.com>
Cc: Barbara Kim <barbara@staffingpartners.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 08:10:43 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview confirmation — Data Engineer (DataViz Labs) — 3/16 10:00am PT

Thanks for the heads up, Daniel — hope you feel better quickly. No problem on our side.

Quick options from our team:
- Move the full panel to Sat 3/17 at 2:00pm PT (60m) — Laura and Monica, are you available?
- Split into two shorter sessions tomorrow afternoon: 2×30m (system design + coding) — Stephanie can cover fit in a follow-up if needed.
- Take-home exercise: we can send a 24-hour coding prompt if you'd rather avoid rescheduling.

If you can confirm a preferred option, we'll send an updated invite and agenda. Attaching Daniel's resume here for reference.

Marcus Lin
Staff Software Engineer — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
415-555-0127

Attachment referenced: Daniel_Park_Resume.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@gmail.com>, Barbara Kim <barbara@staffingpartners.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:05:27 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview confirmation — Data Engineer (DataViz Labs) — 3/16 10:00am PT

Marcus — I can move my calendar and do Sat 3/17 at 2:00pm PT. If we split, I'm fine taking the coding block (30m) at 2:00 and Marcus can do system design at 2:30, then Stephanie for fit at 3:00.

If we go synchronous on Saturday let's keep the agenda tight: 30m coding (Laura), 30m system design (Marcus), 15–20m fit (Stephanie + panel notes). Barbara — can you update the candidate with that plan and send the revised invite?

Laura Bennett
Senior Engineer — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@gmail.com>, Barbara Kim <barbara@staffingpartners.com>

Subject: Re: Interview confirmation — Data Engineer (DataViz Labs) — 3/16 10:00am PT

I can cover ML/data pipelines interview if needed, but Sat 3/17 at 2:00pm PT works for me too. If we keep it to 60m total I'm fine with the split Laura suggested.

If Daniel prefers the take-home, we should confirm scope: 24h, 2–3 problems focusing on data transformation+small model inference. I can draft that quickly and send it to Marcus for review.

Monica Patel
Staff Data Engineer — Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

Thanks, everyone, and really appreciate the flexibility. I just spoke with my doctor and should be fine for a video call tomorrow. Sat 3/17 at 2:00pm PT works best for me. Please send the updated invite and any prep notes (format, whiteboard tool, language expectations).

I've re-attached the doctor's photo here in case DataViz needs documentation: doc_note_park_0316.jpg.

Best,
Daniel
